title: vaccaria hispanica var. grandiflora
intro: Vaccaria hispanica var. grandiflora, commonly known as Autumnal Gentian or Viper's Bugloss, is a perennial plant in the balsam family that is native to Europe. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include expectorant and antiseptic activities, making it an effective treatment for respiratory and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Vaccaria hispanica var. grandiflora include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
